what: Pressing the menu button spreads a circle (clip-path) from the button center to the screen edge in .8s power3.inOut to open the panel, and .32s later the items rise from 50px below at .06s intervals in .7s power3.out. On close, the items retract in .2s and the circle shrinks back to the button in .6s (also via Esc and the close button).

options.items: When items start to appear after opening, default .32
options.[data-fx-part=trigger·panel·item·close]: Open button, cover panel, items that rise in sequence, close button (child)
options.fx:close: Closes when sent to the element (before tapping a link inside the panel to navigate)
options.ease: Easing curve — a GSAP name or four numbers (comma-separated), default power3.inOut · metic is 0.77,0,0.175,1
options.item-ease: Item curve, default power3.out · metic is 0.23,1,0.32,1
options.item-dur: Time for one item to settle in (s), default .7
options.rise: Distance items rise — a px value or ”110%” (share of line height, in which case items rise from a line hidden by overflow with no fade), default 50

from.where: All pages #menu (menu drawer opened from the gear pill at the top right of the header)

All pages .mt-menu — the circle opens in .62s and closes in .48s from the menu button position with cubic-bezier(.77,0,.175,1), and section names rise from 110% below in .7s with lens(.23,1,.32,1) in sequence (this copy: after .12s with .06s gaps).
from.use: data-fx-circle-menu="open: .62; close: .48; ease: 0.77,0,0.175,1; item-ease: 0.23,1,0.32,1; rise: 110%; items: .12"
